notebooks.title: 00 · Dataset exploration
notebooks.summary: Corpus statistics, function-word profiles, and examples of every synthetic image type and test fixture.

notebooks.title: 01 · Text similarity benchmark and threshold calibration
notebooks.summary: 250-pair benchmark of verbatim and paraphrased insertions; Moderate/High thresholds with precision, recall and error analysis.

notebooks.title: 02 · Stylometry evaluation
notebooks.summary: Same- vs different-author separation by text length, label thresholds, supervised attribution on unseen books, clustering.

notebooks.title: 03 · Handwriting and signature features on synthetic data
notebooks.summary: Writer-disjoint evaluation of handwriting features, edge-hinge ablation, robustness to degradations; genuine vs forged synthetic signatures.

notebooks.title: 04 · OCR quality under scanning conditions
notebooks.summary: Tesseract character and word error rates under noise, blur, rotation, low resolution and JPEG; confidence on handwriting.

notebooks.title: 05 · Export the calibration artifact
notebooks.summary: Combines the fitted thresholds into models/calibration.json and records its SHA-256 digest.

notebooks.title: 06 · Photographed pages and copy-move screening
notebooks.summary: Perspective correction of phone photos (corner error, OCR before/after) and copy-move detection by paste size, with false-alarm rates.
